scope: Audit of source-review comments/reports that infer a base no-op or override recipient from decompiler SendMsg spelling. Candidate status is not proof of the actual dispatch target; require the selected PE callsite for that.
search_result: The strongest candidate is the pet-feed message-161 report. A command-action report also asserts override handling for CMode-qualified ranking calls without per-call selected-PE evidence in that report. No CGameObject::SendMsg base-no-op assertion was found in the narrow searched review/test/code set.
